name: KXHIGH cheap-bracket NO
description: Buys NO (IOC at the YES bid, trigger = taker sell print) on KXHIGH brackets whose YES bid is 2-12c, 18-36 h before the local-midnight close; one entry per bracket, held to settlement.
hypothesis: A day ahead the ladder is too wide (implied variance ~1.4x realized), so far brackets priced 2-12c win less than priced. Dev trade screen: +0.9c/ct net (se 0.35-0.6) at 18-36 h, ~0 or negative at other times. Counterparty: retail buying lottery brackets. Wrong if walk-forward CI <= 0, <60% months positive, or lockbox loses. Risk: screen used proven bids but 18-36 h window was read off the screen table (not blind).
